description: This file defines an API service object for QoS-related operations, providing methods to get and update bandwidth and rules, utilizing imported API functions.

methods.name: getBandwidth
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves QoS bandwidth data by calling the imported getQosBandwidth function.

methods.name: updateBandwidth
methods.description: Asynchronously updates QoS bandwidth settings with a provided configuration object.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves QoS rule data by calling the imported getQosRule function.

methods.name: updateRule
methods.description: Asynchronously updates QoS rules with the given request configuration object.
